import json
from pathlib import Path
for name in ('development-ablation-001','bounded-agent-comparison-001'):
 p=Path('docs/experiments/results')/name
 suite=json.loads((p/'frozen-suite.json').read_text()); ledger=json.loads((p/'comparison-ledger.json').read_text()); score=json.loads((p/'comparison-score.json').read_text())
 print(name, 'author',suite['cases'][0]['author_record'])
 print('ledger first',json.dumps(ledger['trials'][0])[:1100]);print('score case',json.dumps(score['cases'][0])[:1100])
 for arm in ('A','B'):
  records=[json.loads(x.read_text()) for x in sorted(p.glob(f'*/{arm}/confirmation/confirmation-result.json'))]
  keys=['preparation_wall_s','execution_and_integrity_wall_s','final_evaluation_wall_s','phase_wall_s']
  print(arm,len(records), {k:sum(r[k] for r in records) for k in keys}, 'runs',sum(r['costs']['physical_rollouts'] for r in records),'nestedwall',sum(r['costs']['known_run_wall_s'] for r in records))
 print('score costs',json.dumps(score['arms']['A']['costs']))
p=Path('artifacts/development-ablation-001/D05-recurrent-carry/A/confirmation/execution')
b=json.loads((p/'bundle.json').read_text());run=b['runs'][1]
print('bundle keys',list(b));print('confirmation',json.dumps(b['confirmation'])[:1200]);print('run keys',list(run));print('run no trace',json.dumps({k:v for k,v in run.items() if k!='trace'})[:8500]);print('trace row',json.dumps(run['trace'][0])[:2500])
